fusions.name: Tacked Sigil
fusions.desc: Tacks a sigil to the target that deals 5 damage and has a 30% chance of leaving it [Exposed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbinding Burst
fusions.desc: Bursts arcana that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring their resistances.

fusions.name: Held Moment
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Primed Rune
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 7 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
